NEAR anatomical LEFT leg reaches forward screen-left, boot about 20 pixels above ground on the 1254 canvas, knee nearly straight, sole facing ground. Near left is still airborne; far right toes support. Preserve near left leg in foreground.
Lock Image1 face, two buns and long tails, torso, two hands and original left-high/right-low spear grip, red/ivory/gold costume and boots, exact full weapon, head/body proportions, subject scale and framing. Entire hair, spear tip/butt and feet inside margins. Actual transparent alpha, no background/floor/shadow/checkerboard/text. Highest visual finish.
